deal.product_description: Portable power station with a 512Wh LiFePO4 battery pack offering long cycle life and stable chemistry. It delivers 800W continuous output with 1,600W peak surge capability and provides 120V pure sine wave AC power, multiple output ports, an LCD status display, and three-way charging options. The unit weighs roughly 13 pounds, making it a reasonably portable option for camping, power outages, or mobile work setups.
